The Problem Statement
• Current physical surveillance systems rely heavily on manual monitoring.
• Existing AI tools in the market are often used in inefficient way.
Research Summary
Integration of face detection, face recognition, and AI features into a real-time web application to automate threat identification and security analytics.

Security First
Robust authentication and authorization protocols to protect sensitive data.

Automation Efficiency
High Efficiency = Low Manpower + Low Cost

Case 3: Static Premises
Centrally mounted AI cameras (45° angle) providing 100% automated monitoring of commercial premises.

🛡️ Multi-tier Login & Role-based Permissions
🛡️ Email Authentication & Supreme User Auth
🛡️ Sha256 Encrypted Passwords
🛡️ Token-based API Security
🛡️ Encrypted Communication & Data Sanitization
🛡️Usage of RESTful API

Target Segments:
• Law Enforcement & Police Officers• Defense Research (DRDO) & Government Agencies• Large-scale Commercial Spaces (Malls, Hubs)
Market Gap:
Current dependence on inefficient manual manpower is costly. Our Edge AI solution transitions from labor-heavy to technology-driven security, ensuring higher profitability and precision.

TRL 4+ Alignment:
• Executed in controlled lab environments and made the precedence for TRL 5.• Validated reliability in simulated field conditions.
Final Conclusion
Ensures civilian safety by controlling entry/exit and reducing risks through a reliable Edge-AI ecosystem. Future versions will be fine-tuned to meet specific commercial market demands.
